name: Grok for PowerPoint
desc: PowerPoint add-in that turns an outline into a researched, finished deck.
desc_zh: PowerPoint 加载项，把大纲变成带资料的成品幻灯片并收紧叙事。
solves: Building a deck means juggling research, layout and story at once; share an outline and the slides, diagrams and images come back.
solves_zh: 做幻灯片要同时顾资料、版面和故事；交出大纲，幻灯片、图示和图片就一起回来。
best_for: You have an outline for tomorrow's review and no time to hunt for charts and images.
best_for_zh: 明天要汇报却只有一份大纲，没时间找图表和配图时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory; channel A Microsoft Marketplace listing）。 Earliest of the four Grok Office add-ins. Single slides, styles and section restructuring are also supported, and Grok asks clarifying questions. The marketplace URL redirects by dropping the locale segment. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在办公软件里的助手，与账本对同类功能的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://x.ai/news/introducing-powerpoint-addin 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/WA200011057?tab=Overview）。
